title: Lumen · Linux engine conformance

coverage: The disjoint 4,200-variant selection is sealed: Lumen 150 has 1,620 fully passing variants versus 1,567 baseline; the Chromium union has 3,532. Primary and expanded Chromium references are fresh; supplemental Chromium remains historical. Six selected entries are explicitly marked jsshell. This selection covers 10.66% of 39,394 testharness variants and is not the full WPT suite.
findings: One-second process-tree CPU/RSS and shared-cgroup monitoring remain required. Compilation shares a 480% CPU budget and at most six compiler jobs.

This dashboard publishes reviewed aggregates, host telemetry and public task feedback. The exact audited accepted-source archive is available at /src.tar.gz; raw results, private runtime paths and directory listings remain unavailable.
Native CSS grammar, intrinsic track sizing, automatic placement and full rendering parity remain incomplete. Accepted scoped repairs do not establish Chromium parity.
